t: How to setup the Ask AI Eleva Chrome Extension
html:
The Ask AI Eleva Chrome Extension allows Ask AI to open webpages, click, type, scroll, and complete supported browser tasks for you.


You can install it by entering a browser-based request in Ask AI and selecting Install when prompted, or by opening the link directly: Eleva – Ask AI listing in the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/Eleva-ask-ai/idbhohjlbibgnelhchaakcpdjkodggpl).

How to Install the Ask AI Eleva Chrome Extension


You can install the AI Eleva directly from this link: Eleva – Ask AI listing in the Chrome Web Store or by following the steps below.


  1. Navigate to Ask AI from the left menu.



  2. Enter a request that requires browser interaction.

    Example: "Open Google Docs and create an event landing page outline."



  3. Select Install when Ask AI prompts you to install the browser extension. You will be redirected to the Eleva – Ask AI listing in the Chrome Web Store.



  4. On the Chrome Web Store page, select Add to Chrome.



  5. Review the extension permissions, then select Add extension.
